findings.title: Account Lockout Threshold 1 to 5 Attempts
findings.description: Account lockout must trigger after 1-5 failed logon attempts. Value 0 means "never lock" which allows unlimited brute-force attempts and must FAIL. Values greater than 5 also fail this control.

remediation.action: Set via Group Policy: Computer Configuration > Windows Settings > Security Settings > Account Policies > Account Lockout Policy > "Account lockout threshold" = 5 or fewer (but not 0).

findings.title: Windows Defender Antivirus Enabled
findings.description: Windows Defender real-time monitoring must be enabled. Note: command returns False when protection IS enabled (DisableRealtimeMonitoring=False).

findings.title: Windows Firewall Domain Profile Enabled
findings.description: Windows Firewall must be enabled for the Domain profile to block unauthorized inbound connections on domain-joined endpoints.

remediation.action: Enable Windows Firewall for Domain profile via Group Policy (Computer Configuration > Windows Settings > Security Settings > Windows Firewall with Advanced Security) or: Set-NetFirewallProfile -Name Domain -Enabled True

findings.title: Windows Firewall Private Profile Enabled
findings.description: Windows Firewall Private profile must be enabled to block unauthorized inbound connections on private networks (work/home).

remediation.action: Enable Windows Firewall Private profile via Group Policy or netsh

findings.title: Windows Firewall Public Profile Enabled
findings.description: Windows Firewall Public profile must be enabled to block unauthorized inbound connections on public networks.

remediation.action: Enable Windows Firewall Public profile via Group Policy or netsh

findings.title: Guest Account Disabled
findings.description: Built-in Guest account must be disabled to prevent anonymous access.

remediation.action: Disable Guest account via 'Local Users and Groups' or net user

findings.title: LM Hash Storage Disabled
findings.description: LM hash must be disabled. NoLMHash=1 or missing key (modern Windows default) = PASS. NoLMHash=0 = LM hash enabled = FAIL.

remediation.action: Set NoLMHash to 1 in registry to explicitly disable LM hash storage

findings.title: Password Complexity Enabled
findings.description: Password complexity must be enabled to require mixed character sets. On domain-joined machines, secedit reflects the effective (domain) policy. On standalone machines, it reflects local policy. Single source of truth.

remediation.action: Set via Group Policy: Computer Configuration > Windows Settings > Security Settings > Account Policies > Password Policy > "Password must meet complexity requirements" = Enabled.

findings.title: Minimum Password Length 14 Characters or More
findings.description: Minimum password length must be at least 14 characters to resist brute-force and dictionary attacks. Value is read from the effective local security policy via secedit export.

remediation.action: Set via Group Policy: Computer Configuration > Windows Settings > Security Settings > Account Policies > Password Policy > "Minimum password length" = 14 or more. Or via secedit /configure with a custom INF.

findings.title: RDP Network Level Authentication Required
findings.description: RDP must require Network Level Authentication (NLA) to prevent unauthenticated access to the login screen and reduce RDP attack surface.

remediation.action: Set via Group Policy: Computer Configuration > Administrative Templates > Windows Components > Remote Desktop Services > Remote Desktop Session Host > Security > "Require user authentication for remote connections by using Network Level Authentication" = Enabled. Or set registry UserAuthentication = 1.

findings.title: Remote Registry Service Disabled
findings.description: Remote Registry service allows remote modification of registry. Should be set to Disabled (Start=4) unless explicitly required for administration.

remediation.action: Set service to Disabled: Set-Service -Name RemoteRegistry -StartupType Disabled Or: sc.exe config RemoteRegistry start= disabled

findings.title: Screen Saver Timeout <= 900 Seconds
findings.description: Screen saver must activate within 15 minutes (900 seconds) of inactivity. Missing key = no screen lock configured = FAIL.

remediation.action: Set ScreenSaveTimeOut to 900 or less (seconds) via Group Policy

findings.title: SMBv1 Protocol Disabled
findings.description: SMBv1 is deprecated and vulnerable (EternalBlue, WannaCry). Must be disabled on all endpoints.

remediation.action: Disable SMBv1 via 'Turn Windows features on or off' or PowerShell

findings.title: User Account Control (UAC) Enabled
findings.description: UAC must be enabled (EnableLUA=1) to enforce privilege separation and prevent unauthorized elevation.

remediation.action: Set EnableLUA to 1 in registry or via Group Policy
